history.body: Hi, I’m looking at Pearl Residences because we’re hoping to buy somewhere around Seberang Jaya. Could you tell me what the 3-bedroom units are like and roughly what the monthly costs would be?

Phase 1’s main 3-bedroom option is Type A: 900 sq ft, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. It has an open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, plus a short internal corridor and a small storage area. Maintenance is RM0.18 per sq ft, inclusive of sinking fund; selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use. I’ll confirm the current monthly total and any other recurring charges before quoting a figure.

Thanks, that helps. RM162 a month for maintenance sounds manageable. Is Type A currently available, and does the price usually include a car park? I’d also be interested in the full monthly charges once you’ve confirmed them.

Good to hear RM162 a month for maintenance feels manageable. I wouldn’t assume the car park is included—the allocation and price can depend on the specific unit. I’ll verify current Type A availability and car-park inclusion for the available options. I’ve noted your request for the full monthly charges too.
